info.name: Foreign Exchange Rates CTP Consumer Management API API

items.docs: Enrolls a new consumer into the Click to Pay ecosystem, creating a profile that can store payment credentials for streamlined checkout experiences across participating merchants.

params.name: consumerId
params.description: Unique identifier for the enrolled consumer

items.docs: Adds a new payment credential to an existing consumer profile. The credential is tokenized and stored securely for use in future Click to Pay transactions.
